name: Mall Outside Corner Floor 2 m
summary: A 2 m outside-corner floor with twin mitred champagne lines around an inset eucalyptus terrazzo ribbon.
description: A 2 m outside-corner floor with twin mitred champagne lines around an inset eucalyptus terrazzo ribbon.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original Blender mesh cuts in the native 2 m straight-floor source, with true diagonal joints, a flush colored-stone border and a baked material response for distant use.
accuracy_notes: The three digital meshes have a measured 2 × 2 m footprint and a level 100 mm wearing surface. The two indexed metal arms meet across 45-degree cuts. Device performance and physical construction suitability require separate evaluation.

attribution.credit: Original derivative of the owner-project mall-floor-module-2m mesh, using the original seed 421 terrazzo artwork. Corner geometry, smoked finish and baked response authored for Blender-3D-Gallery.

rights: Original owner-project geometry and texture. Reuse in the owner’s projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms are unspecified.
